name: Scramble From The Start
description: Makes the scramble button both VISIBLE (Book:LoadChapterResources) and ENABLED (BattleEngine OnPanComplete / AttackTooltipCallback / BossBattleUpdate) from chapter 1.1, by neutralizing the `chapter >= 4` gates that normally keep it greyed out until Book 1 chapter 4. Also skips the Book 1 chapter 4 scramble TUTORIAL (Tutorial.Chap4ScrambleUpdate): that scripted lesson assumes scramble is still locked and crashes the game on entering 1.4 once scramble is already enabled, so it is torn down immediately (RestoreState / RemoveOverlayCallback / IntroDialogComplete) and the chapter proceeds normally.
author: you

markers: Press scramble now and try it out!
